checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15-second 16:9 film tells the story in three distinct shots.
must.why: Only frames from two clips (shots 1 and 2) were provided. Shot 3 is not shown. The shots seen are 16:9 and realistic, but the story is not clearly told.

must.item: The woman retains the same facial structure, freckles and red pixie cut in all three shots.
must.why: She looks consistent across the shot 1 and shot 2 frames, with freckles and a red bob/pixie cut. Shot 3 is not shown.

must.item: The man retains the same facial structure, shaved head and round glasses in all three shots; the two identities never merge or swap.
must.why: He looks consistent in shots 1 and 2, with a shaved head and round glasses. Shot 3 is not shown, and his face is obscured in part of shot 2.

must.item: Both faces are clearly visible in every shot, not hidden by rear views, distant framing or object-only cutaways.
must.why: In shot 2 the man bends down with his face hidden at 4.8s and partly blurred at 3.5s. Shot 3 is not shown.

must.item: The red scarf is dropped by the woman, picked up by the man and returned to her in that order, ending with mutual smiles.
must.why: The drop is not clearly shown in shot 1. In shot 2 the man ends up wearing the scarf. There is no return or smiles in the frames seen.

must.item: The film looks realistic and has no audible soundtrack.
must.why: The frames look photoreal, with a plausible street and lighting. The soundtrack cannot be checked from stills, but it was reported as silent.

faults.what: Shot 1 never clearly shows the woman dropping the scarf. She wears it at 0.5s and 2s, and by 3.5s a red blob sits at the frame edge. In the last frames she has no scarf, so the drop is ambiguous and not visible.
In shot 2 the man bends over at 4.8s with his face hidden or turned away, and his face is partly turned and blurred at 3.5s. This breaks the 'both faces clearly visible' requirement.
In shot 2 the man puts the scarf around his own neck instead of picking it up and keeping it to return. This contradicts the story.

The shot 2 frames show the man bent over and then wearing the scarf. This suggests he walks beside the woman and she never walks ahead, unlike the story the assistant described. The woman stays in the same stoic pose and never reacts.
No shot 3 frames were provided, so the return of the scarf and the mutual smiles are not shown. Neither smile appears in any frame seen.
The woman's coat and face are consistent, but her expression stays neutral and slightly grim. The mood does not match the warm 'kindness' moment the user asked for.
The shot 1 frames at 0.5s and 2s show a mild perspective and face shift (the woman turned to the side). The AI look is slightly soft.

summary: The two clips seen are realistic and keep both identities consistent, but the scarf drop is unclear, the man bends with his face hidden and then wears the scarf, and no return or smiles are shown.
